1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with a light-activated MTP affixed thereto, wherein the MTP is responsive to light activation for identification purposes.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded in the test tube.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards through the bottom.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube configured for long-term storage of biological samples.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer and is responsive to light activation.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for storing and tracking samples comprising: the assembly of claim 1; and at least one of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes configured to hold multiple assemblies; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes, wherein the system includes light-activation capability for reading the light-activated MTPs.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, wherein the racks and test tubes are stored and handled at temperatures of -20°C or less, and wherein the light-activation reading capability functions at such low temperatures.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: heating a light-activated MTP to above the melting point of plastic; and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated light-activated MTP to embed it within the plastic material.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading a light-activated MTP embedded in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing the test tube assembly with the embedded light-activated MTP; and activating and reading the light-activated MTP using light activation.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded light-activated MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards through the bottom.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards through the bottom.
